templates.pat: The following discloses our information gathering and dissemination practices for the Broad Institute Single Cell Portal website ({{1}})
templates.zh: 以下说明布罗德研究所 Single Cell Portal 网站（{{1}}）的信息收集与传播做法

templates.pat: The Single Cell Portal uses the information gathered above to enable integration with Google-based services that require a Google account, such as {{1}} and Google Cloud Storage Platform. We may also use this information to provide you with the services on the platform and to communicate with you (e.g., about new feature announcements, unplanned site maintenance, and general notices). If you'd like to opt-out of receiving communications from our team, you can choose to do so through your profile settings. At no time do we disclose any user information to outside sources. Web server logs are retained on a temporary basis and then deleted completely from our systems. User information is stored in a password-protected database, and OAuth tokens are only stored for the length of an active session, is encrypted at rest (using 256-bit AES encryption), and is deleted upon sign out.
templates.zh: Single Cell Portal 使用上述收集的信息，以便与需要 Google 账户的 Google 服务（例如 {{1}} 和 Google Cloud Storage Platform）集成。我们也可能使用这些信息向您提供平台上的服务并与您沟通（例如新功能公告、计划外站点维护和一般通知）。如果您希望不再接收我们团队的通信，可以在个人资料设置中选择退出。我们绝不会向外部来源披露任何用户信息。Web 服务器日志会临时保留，随后从我们的系统中彻底删除。用户信息存储在受密码保护的数据库中，OAuth 令牌仅在会话活跃期间存储，静态时加密（使用 256 位 AES 加密），并在退出登录时删除。

templates.pat: If you have any questions about this privacy statement, the practices of this site, or your dealings with this site, you can contact us through {{1}}.
templates.zh: 如果您对本隐私声明、本网站的做法或您与本网站的往来有任何疑问，可通过 {{1}} 联系我们。
